title: Burning Rangers
native_title: バーニング・レンジャー
overview:
In a future where fire is the last great threat to human life, the Burning Rangers are the elite firefighters called in when disaster strikes. Choose Shou Amabane or Tillis and charge into blazing facilities in this 3D action adventure from Sonic Team.

Put out fires, collect the energy crystals they leave behind and use them to send trapped civilians to safety. Hold on to your crystals - they protect you from harm. Boost with your jetpack to reach high places, swim through flooded areas and fight off hostile robots and powerful bosses, while your mission controller's voice guides you through each building.

- For 1 player, compatible with the multi controller
- Memory backup support
- Comes with a bonus theme song CD
